units.source_text: 结果，什么也没开始，什么也没结束。

en.t: In the end, nothing had begun, and nothing had ended.

units.source_text: 满足了欲望的仿佛不是他，而是别人，简直就像把他的身体借给了别人似的。

en.t: It seemed that the one whose desire had been satisfied was not him, but someone else, almost as if he had lent his body to another person.

units.source_text: 性嘛，本来就不是单个的肉体，也许属于物种的管辖……

en.t: Sex, after all, may not belong to a single body in the first place, but to the jurisdiction of the species...

units.source_text: 完成了任务的个体，必须尽快地返回原来的位置。

en.t: The individual who has completed the task must return to his original position as quickly as possible.

units.source_text: 面临死亡的人走向死亡之床……

en.t: The person facing death goes toward the deathbed...

units.source_text: 很容易就能厚颜无耻地坚信，这种诈骗是一种野性之恋……

en.t: It is all too easy to brazenly convince oneself that this kind of deception is a wild form of love...

units.source_text: 同联票的性比较起来，有什么可取之处吗？

en.t: Compared with ticket-book sex, is there anything commendable about it at all?

units.source_text: 做这种事，真还不如做个玻璃制的禁欲主义者。

en.t: Rather than do something like this, one would really be better off as an ascetic made of glass.
